#
# Reproduce with, at http://app.aspell.net/create :
#   max_size=35  spelling=US  max_variant=0  diacritic=strip   -> ANSWERS
#   max_size=70  spelling=US  max_variant=0  diacritic=strip   -> GUESSES
# then keep the lowercase ASCII words of exactly five letters.
#
# Two lists because they answer different questions. What is fair to ask
# for is a much smaller set than what is acceptable to offer, and SCOWL's
# levels are cumulative — so every answer is also an accepted guess, and
# the game cannot refuse its own word. Asserted in wordLists.test.ts.
#
# Fetched 2026-09-06. SCOWL may publish a revision; nothing here will
# notice, which is deliberate: a word list that changed under players
# would be worse than one slightly out of date.
ANSWERS 
GUESSES
